phases.name: Make the value obvious
phases.outcome: A stranger can understand the product and reach demo value in under five minutes.

phases.name: Earn the first believers
phases.outcome: Fifteen qualified users have installed the product and at least five use it weekly.

phases.name: Launch one useful story at a time
phases.outcome: Every supported community has seen a tailored, evidence-backed demonstration.

phases.name: Turn proof into a durable release
phases.outcome: A polished v1 and user proof create a credible push to 1,000 stars.

events.deliverable: Record the baseline stars, forks, clones, visitors, installs, and activation proxy.
Lock the one-sentence promise and searchable project name.
Ship the outcome-first README, real screenshots, and a 30–60 second demo.
Ship sample-data demo mode and a five-minute quickstart.
Cut a tested release candidate and recruit five installation testers.
Publish the design-partner call through approved owned channels.
Submit to two relevant open-source directories after reviewing their rules.
Hold the first public installation office hour for opted-in applicants.
Review conversion, activation, and the 100-star target; change the message if visitors do not activate.
Prepare the Show HN story with a working demo and founder available for replies.
Human reviews and submits Show HN; answer every substantive comment.
Complete five opted-in interviews and publish the anonymized learning summary.
Publish a Codex-specific workflow demonstration in an approved channel.
Open three scoped, verified contributor tasks with maintainer context.
Run installation office hours and personally unblock opted-in users.
Publish the observation-first architecture article.
Review applications, qualified partners, installs, weekly use, and response time.
Review the 300-star target and select the strongest validated use case.
Publish a read-only OpenClaw fleet visibility demonstration in an approved channel.
Release the highest-impact design-partner fixes with before/after evidence.
Publish the self-hosting, privacy, and outbound-connectivity story.
Publish the first approved design-partner case study with a measurable outcome.
Submit to two additional curated directories using a channel-specific description.
Demonstrate the most-requested new integration end to end.
Hold an opt-in roundtable with adjacent open-source maintainers; publish shared lessons, not pitches.
Publish the durable attention-routing and capability-safety article.
Review the 600-star target, weekly active installs, retention, and support load.
Lock v1 to proven workflows and publish the compatibility matrix.
Publish a second approved case study from a different user profile.
Publish the v1 release candidate and ask existing users to run the verification checklist.
Refresh the demo video with v1 workflows and real, approved proof points.
Prepare tailored v1 launch drafts and a maintainer reply rota.
Human reviews and publishes v1 through owned and approved community channels.
Amplify opt-in user demonstrations with explicit attribution and permission.
Publish what changed after 90 days, including misses and product lessons.
Review the 1,000-star target and choose the next goal from retention and user outcomes.
